recentItems.title: Shooting the Canon EOS 1000F/Rebel S with Kodak Gold | Film Photography Fridays
recentItems.description:
In this week's Film Photography Friday I review and chat about Jess' experience shooting the Canon 1000F/1000FN/ Rebel S with Kodak Gold 200 film. The Canon 1000F is a very versatile 35mm autofocus film SLR that works with all the modern EOS lenses. If you're lucky you can get these at a great price with a great lens that will work on your modern Canon DSLR.

recentItems.title: Budget Contax T2? | Olympus AF-1 and Kodak Gold 200
recentItems.description:
In this weeks Film Photography Friday I review my experience shooting the Olympus AF1 Super with Kodak Gold 200 film  in Ireland. The Olympus AF1 is a compact point and shoot camera which shares its beautiful f2.8 Zuiko lens with the Olympus XA which I have reviewed on the channel before. Honestly this is one of my favourite point and shoots as its quality isn't far off the infamous Contax T2 although I don't have to worry about keeping it safe as much as I would with one of my Contax T2s.

If you enjoy the Film Photography Friday series and would like to help support the channel by donating the price of a roll of film a month you can do so here and I would massively appreciate it! 
: https://www.patreon.com/aaronfleming

New episode's of Film Photography Friday will be going to be live every Friday at 7pm so if you enjoyed this video about my Olympus AF1 and Kodak Gold 200 then be sure to like, share, subscribe and most importantly turn on that notification bell! ( I promise I won't spam you!)

Check out the other Film Photography Friday episodes here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7Zr12LNbdDI&list=PLP9KMAM_L9zswC-r37Mlqvz9OgGbjdV3S&index=2
